library.name: Plotly.js
library.description: Renders every chart in this plugin's Quiz Analytics section (Question Analytics, Solution Process Visualization, and the course-wide Analytics page) — vendored locally rather than loaded from a CDN so no student response data or chart content ever leaves the Moodle server's own network.

library.name: KaTeX
library.description: Client-side rendering of STACK/Maxima LaTeX (\( \), \[ \], and $ ... $ delimited math) in tables, question text, and notes — vendored locally for the same reason as Plotly.js above.

library.name: TCPDF
library.description: Generates the Quiz Analytics section's "Generate PDF Report" downloads (Question Analytics, Solution Process Visualization, Quiz Analysis) server-side in pure PHP — no external binaries or services needed. Vendored as a trimmed copy of the classic 6.x release (core Helvetica + DejaVu Sans fonts only, barcode modules and other font families removed) rather than the 7.x line, which is a deprecated Composer-only facade requiring PHP 8.2+ and a separate tc-lib-pdf package graph incompatible with this plugin's no-Composer, vendor-locally convention. The Model Analytics section's own PDF export uses Moodle core's own bundled TCPDF (lib/pdflib.php) instead, so nothing there is vendored.
